mapper.sql: FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id JOIN category parent ON parent.id=c.parent_id LEFT JOIN fragrance_family f ON f.id=p.family_id
mapper.select:
SELECT ,p.description,p.usage_notes,p.material,p.power_info,p.contents
WHERE p.active=TRUE AND c.enabled=TRUE AND parent.enabled=TRUE AND p.stock>0 AND p.category_id IN (101,102,203,401,402,403,504) ORDER BY p.id IN (1001,1005,1010,1014,1015,1016,1021,2015,2051,2052) DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT 80
SELECT ,p.description ORDER BY p.price_cents ASC,p.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT JOIN product_compatibility r ON (r.product_id=#{id} AND r.related_product_id=p.id) OR (r.related_product_id=#{id} AND r.product_id=p.id) WHERE p.active=TRUE AND c.enabled=TRUE AND parent.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id=#{categoryId},family_id=#{familyId},name=#{name},subtitle=#{subtitle},spec=#{spec},unit=#{unit}, price_cents=#{priceCents},active=#{active},image_path=#{imagePath},scent_image_path=#{scentImagePath},scene_image_path=#{sceneImagePath},description=#{description},usage_notes=#{usageNotes}, material=#{material},power_info=#{powerInfo},contents=#{contents},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
